concerns.text: The plan states that a paired Wilcoxon signed‑rank test will be performed with a Bonferroni correction (α = 0.05) to satisfy FR‑008 and SC‑002, but two ensemble models (Random Forest and Gradient Boosting) are compared against a linear‑regression baseline. This constitutes multiple comparisons; the description should clarify whether each model is tested separately (requiring α = 0.025 per test) or a single omnibus test is intended. Adjust the wording to reflect the exact statistical procedure and correction applied.
